content: {"episode_id":"ep-05089","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-22","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-22 denial of CPT 93229, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, for this episode. The clinical indication note documents intermittent palpitations (R00.2) and episodes of dizziness (R42) that are concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate these symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias, as stated in the indication. Because CO-22 asserts coordination of benefits rather than a clinical determination, we request reconsideration of this medically necessary service and the outstanding balance of 709.93."}
